variants.spec: Unconditional always-on equal-weight BTC/ETH 1:1 spot-long/USD-M-perp-short basis carry, entry-and-hold (deploy once 2020-08-01 00:00 UTC, hold to final bar close; within-sleeve notional fixed at entry, no rebalances)

variants.selection_reason: not selected: the equal-notional retarget mechanically sells winners and buys losers each day (mean-reversion drag inside the premium), plus 365x more fee events; dev 2x excess 0.205 vs 2.573 for hold
not selected: same rebalance-drag effect, weaker (weekly); loses to entry-and-hold on both return and 2x excess
not selected: best rebalancer as predicted (least drag), but still dominated by entry-and-hold (0.367 vs 2.573 dev 2x excess)
